---
title: "Discard tonnes on slow VMS pings"
output:
  html_document:
    toc: true
    toc_float: true
---

Reported catch is already placed on slow VMS pings in
[`step3_allocate_catch_to_pings.Rmd`](step3_allocate_catch_to_pings.Rmd).
This notebook turns that catch into discard tonnes.

The discard rate is tonnes discarded per tonne of total catch, from
`gear_fao_b1_crosswalk.csv`. Total catch is landings plus discards, and the
ping table holds landings. Discard tonnes on a ping are

`catch_tonnes × discard_rate / (1 − discard_rate)`.

One rate is applied to the whole permit. The catch on the ping is already
that vessel's share of its business's landings, summed across species.

Landings with no slow ping are left out. Most of those vessel IDs are not
in the permit registry, so they have no gear or target to join. They stay
in the comparison below, as the part of each region's catch that does not
receive a discard estimate.

```{r setup}
library(tidyverse)
library(terra)
library(sf)
library(knitr)

knitr::opts_chunk$set(message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)

ping_path <- "/home/shares/ohi/OHI_GOC/goal_prep/pressures/vessels/catch_allocation/catch_tonnes_by_ping.csv"
comparison_path <- "/home/shares/ohi/OHI_GOC/goal_prep/pressures/vessels/catch_allocation/catch_allocation_vs_records.csv"

marine_path <- "/home/frazier/ohi_goc_prep/spatial/ohi_regions/ohi_marine_raster_1km.tif"
landings_path <- "/home/shares/ohi/OHI_GOC/goal_prep/fp/cleaned_CONAPESCA/GOC_Marine.Landings_Sector.Sorted.Georef_PATCHED_Jun032026.rds"
region_path <- "/home/frazier/ohi_goc_prep/spatial/ohi_regions/goc_ohi_rgns.shp"

out_dir <- "/home/shares/ohi/OHI_GOC/goal_prep/pressures/vessels/catch_allocation"
fig_dir <- "/home/frazier/ohi_goc_prep/_pressures/vessels/figures"
data_dir <- "/home/frazier/ohi_goc_prep/_pressures/vessels/data"
dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(fig_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# Same sector list used to build the catch file in the CPUE notebook.
sectors <- c(
  "marine: fishery sector yet to be classified",
  "marine: small-scale capture",
  "marine: large-scale capture",
  "freshwater or marine: large-scale capture",
  "freshwater or marine: small-scale capture",

ohi_marine <- ifel(ohi_id >= 1, 1, NA)
```

## 1. Attach a discard rate to each ping

A permit with both gear and target missing is a real row in the crosswalk
(the mixed rate). A normal join does not match missing to missing, so the
blank pair is given its own key.

```{r rates}
permit_key <- function(gear, target) {
  paste(coalesce(gear, "BLANK"), coalesce(target, "BLANK"), sep = " || ")
}

rates <- read_csv(
  rate_path,
  col_types = cols(
    gear_type = col_character(),
    target_species = col_character(),
    discard_category = col_character(),
    discard_rate = col_double(),
    .default = col_skip()
  )
) %>%
  mutate(permit_key = permit_key(gear_type, target_species)) %>%
  select(permit_key, discard_category, discard_rate)

stopifnot(anyDuplicated(rates$permit_key) == 0)

pings <- read_csv(
  ping_path,
  col_types = cols(
    year = col_integer(),
    eu_rnpa = col_character(),
    lat = col_double(),
    lon = col_double(),
    gear_type = col_character(),
    target_species = col_character(),
    catch_tonnes = col_double(),
    .default = col_skip()
  )
) %>%
  mutate(
    permit_key = permit_key(gear_type, target_species),
    eu_rnpa = as.character(eu_rnpa)
  ) %>%
  left_join(rates, by = "permit_key") %>%
  mutate(
    discard_tonnes = catch_tonnes * discard_rate / (1 - discard_rate)
  )

unmatched <- pings %>%
  filter(is.na(discard_rate)) %>%
  count(gear_type, target_species, name = "n_pings")

stopifnot(nrow(unmatched) == 0)
stopifnot(all(pings$discard_rate < 1))

cat(
  "Pings:", nrow(pings), "\n",
  "Landings on pings, t:", round(sum(pings$catch_tonnes)), "\n",
  "Discards on pings, t:", round(sum(pings$discard_tonnes)), "\n"
)
```

## 2. Region of each ping, and the discard map

The region is the marine-grid cell the ping falls in. Cells are numbered 1
to 9. Pings outside those nine regions keep a discard estimate and stay off
the map.

```{r region-and-raster}
region_labels <- st_read(region_path, quiet = TRUE) %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  filter(location == "marine") %>%
  arrange(rgn_id) %>%
  transmute(
    ohi_rgn = rgn_id,
    region_label = paste(rgn_id, str_replace_all(estado, "_", " "), str_replace_all(ecorgn, "_", " "), sep = " · "),
    trend_label = paste0(rgn_id, " · ", ecorgn)
  )

region_palette <- setNames(
  hcl.colors(nrow(region_labels), palette = "Zissou1"),
  region_labels$trend_label
)

discard_raster <- ifel(!is.na(ohi_marine), 0, NA)
names(discard_raster) <- "discard_tonnes"
discard_raster_2024 <- NULL

years <- sort(unique(pings$year))
placed_units <- pings %>% distinct(year, eu_rnpa)
region_parts <- vector("list", length(years))

for (i in seq_along(years)) {
  yr <- years[[i]]
  d <- pings %>% filter(year == yr)
  pts <- vect(as.matrix(d[, c("lon", "lat")]), crs = "EPSG:4326")
  pts <- project(pts, crs(ohi_id))
  d$cell <- cellFromXY(ohi_id, crds(pts))
  d$rgn_num <- values(ohi_id)[d$cell]

  inside <- d %>% filter(!is.na(rgn_num))
  cell_sum <- inside %>%
    group_by(cell) %>%
    summarise(discard_tonnes = sum(discard_tonnes), .groups = "drop")
  discard_raster[cell_sum$cell] <- discard_raster[cell_sum$cell] + cell_sum$discard_tonnes
  if (yr == 2024) {
    discard_raster_2024 <- ifel(!is.na(ohi_marine), 0, NA)
    discard_raster_2024[cell_sum$cell] <- cell_sum$discard_tonnes
    names(discard_raster_2024) <- "discard_tonnes"
  }

  region_parts[[i]] <- d %>%
    mutate(ohi_rgn = if_else(is.na(rgn_num), NA_character_, paste0("Region_", rgn_num))) %>%
    group_by(year, ohi_rgn) %>%
    summarise(
      catch_tonnes = sum(catch_tonnes),
      discard_tonnes = sum(discard_tonnes),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  message(
    yr, ": ", round(sum(inside$discard_tonnes)), " t discards inside the grid, ",
    round(sum(d$discard_tonnes[is.na(d$rgn_num)])), " t outside"
  )
  rm(d, pts, inside, cell_sum)
  gc(verbose = FALSE)
}

ping_by_region <- list_rbind(region_parts)
```

```{r save-raster}
raster_path <- file.path(out_dir, "discard_tonnes_2018_2024_1km.tif")
discard_plot_raster <- ifel(discard_raster > 0, discard_raster, NA)
names(discard_plot_raster) <- "discard_tonnes"
writeRaster(discard_plot_raster, raster_path, overwrite = TRUE)

cat("Discard tonnes inside the grid:", round(global(discard_plot_raster, "sum", na.rm = TRUE)[1, 1]), "\n")

raster_2024_path <- file.path(out_dir, "discard_tonnes_2024_1km.tif")
discard_2024_plot_raster <- ifel(discard_raster_2024 > 0, discard_raster_2024, NA)
names(discard_2024_plot_raster) <- "discard_tonnes"
writeRaster(discard_2024_plot_raster, raster_2024_path, overwrite = TRUE)
```

```{r plot-raster}
plot_df <- as.data.frame(discard_plot_raster, xy = TRUE, na.rm = TRUE)
names(plot_df)[3] <- "discard_tonnes"

raster_plot <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x, y, fill = discard_tonnes)) +
  geom_raster() +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    trans = "sqrt",
    name = "Tonnes",
    labels = scales::label_comma()
  ) +
  coord_equal() +
  labs(
    title = "Discard tonnes on slow VMS pings, 2018–2024",
    subtitle = "Landings on the ping, converted with the permit discard rate. Color scale is square-root.",
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text = element_blank(), axis.ticks = element_blank())

print(raster_plot)
ggsave(
  file.path(fig_dir, "discard_tonnes_2018_2024_1km.png"),
  raster_plot,
  width = 8,
  height = 7,
  dpi = 150,
  bg = "white"
)
```

## 3. Landings with no slow ping

These landings are in the catch file and are not on the ping table. The
region is the landing site's `OHI_region_est`, not a fishing position. That
is the only region available for boats that were not tracked. They are used
here as the denominator of the coverage share, and they are not given
discard tonnes.

```{r untracked}
landings <- readRDS(landings_path)
landings <- landings[
  landings$year %in% years & landings$sector_estimate_draft %in% sectors,
  c("year", "eu_rnpa", "OHI_region_est", "weight_kg_corrected")
]
landings$eu_rnpa <- as.character(landings$eu_rnpa)
landings$placed <- paste(landings$year, landings$eu_rnpa) %in%
  paste(placed_units$year, placed_units$eu_rnpa)

untracked <- landings %>%
  filter(!placed) %>%
  group_by(year, ohi_rgn = OHI_region_est) %>%
  summarise(untracked_catch_tonnes = sum(weight_kg_corrected, na.rm = TRUE) / 1000, .groups = "drop")

rm(landings)
gc(verbose = FALSE)

# The gap in the catch comparison should equal these landings.
gap <- read_csv(
  comparison_path,
  col_types = cols(
    year = col_integer(),
    record_tonnes = col_double(),
    allocated_tonnes = col_double(),
    .default = col_skip()
  )
) %>%
  mutate(gap_tonnes = record_tonnes - allocated_tonnes) %>%
  left_join(
    untracked %>% group_by(year) %>% summarise(untracked_catch_tonnes = sum(untracked_catch_tonnes), .groups = "drop"),
    by = "year"
  )

stopifnot(max(abs(gap$gap_tonnes - gap$untracked_catch_tonnes)) < 1)
```

## 4. Discard tonnes by region, and the share of catch they cover

For each region and year, discard tonnes are the sum of the ping estimates
that fall in that region. The share is

`ping catch in the region / (ping catch in the region + untracked landings assigned to the region)`.

Ping catch is where the tracked boats were fishing. Untracked landings are
where those other boats landed. A region can therefore mix the two. Regions
where most boats are small and untracked have a low share, because most of
their landings have no permit to score.

Pings that miss the nine regions are listed under the regional tables. They
have a discard estimate and no region.

```{r summary}
regions <- tibble(ohi_rgn = paste0("Region_", 1:9))

by_region <- regions %>%
  crossing(year = years) %>%
  left_join(ping_by_region %>% filter(!is.na(ohi_rgn)), by = c("year", "ohi_rgn")) %>%
  left_join(untracked %>% filter(!is.na(ohi_rgn)), by = c("year", "ohi_rgn")) %>%
  mutate(
    catch_tonnes = coalesce(catch_tonnes, 0),
    discard_tonnes = coalesce(discard_tonnes, 0),
    untracked_catch_tonnes = coalesce(untracked_catch_tonnes, 0),
    pct_catch_with_discard_estimate = 100 * catch_tonnes / (catch_tonnes + untracked_catch_tonnes),
    discard_per_catch = discard_tonnes / catch_tonnes
  ) %>%
  left_join(region_labels, by = "ohi_rgn") %>%
  arrange(year, ohi_rgn)

summary_path <- file.path(data_dir, "discard_tonnes_by_ohi_rgn.csv")
write_csv(
  by_region %>%
    select(
      year, ohi_rgn, region_label, catch_tonnes, discard_tonnes,
      discard_per_catch, untracked_catch_tonnes, pct_catch_with_discard_estimate
    ),
  summary_path
)

# Catch-weighted discard rate: discards / (landings + discards). Same columns
# as the other files in vessels/output.
output_dir <- "/home/frazier/ohi_goc_prep/_pressures/vessels/output"
dir.create(output_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
discards_pressure_path <- file.path(output_dir, "discards_pressure.csv")
discards_pressure <- by_region %>%
  transmute(
    rgn_id = ohi_rgn,
    year = year,
    pressure = discard_tonnes / (catch_tonnes + discard_tonnes)
  ) %>%
  arrange(year, rgn_id)
write_csv(discards_pressure, discards_pressure_path)

outside <- ping_by_region %>%
  filter(is.na(ohi_rgn)) %>%
  select(year, catch_tonnes, discard_tonnes)

no_region_landings <- untracked %>%
  filter(is.na(ohi_rgn)) %>%
  select(year, untracked_catch_tonnes)
```

### 2024

```{r table-2024}
kable(
  by_region %>%
    filter(year == 2024) %>%
    select(region_label, catch_tonnes, discard_tonnes, untracked_catch_tonnes, pct_catch_with_discard_estimate),
  digits = c(0, 0, 0, 0, 0),
  col.names = c(
    "Region",
    "Ping catch, t",
    "Discards, t",
    "Untracked landings, t",
    "Share of catch with a discard estimate, %"
  ),
  caption = "2024. Discards are estimated for the ping catch only. The share is ping catch divided by ping catch plus untracked landings assigned to that region."
)
```

```{r plot-share-2024}
share_plot <- by_region %>%
  filter(year == 2024) %>%
  ggplot(aes(reorder(region_label, pct_catch_with_discard_estimate), pct_catch_with_discard_estimate)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#2c7fb8") +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 100), breaks = seq(0, 100, 20)) +
  labs(
    title = "Share of 2024 catch with a discard estimate",
    subtitle = "Ping catch in the region, divided by ping catch plus untracked landings at sites in the region.",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Percent"
  ) +
  theme_bw()

print(share_plot)
ggsave(
  file.path(fig_dir, "discard_catch_share_by_region_2024.png"),
  share_plot,
  width = 8,
  height = 5,
  dpi = 150,
  bg = "white"
)
```

Across the whole Gulf in 2024, the discard estimate covers the catch placed
on slow pings, including pings that miss the nine regions. Untracked
landings are the rest.

```{r gulf-2024}
gulf_2024 <- gap %>% filter(year == 2024)
cat(
  "Gulf landings:", round(gulf_2024$record_tonnes), "t\n",
  "Catch with a discard estimate:", round(gulf_2024$allocated_tonnes), "t (",
  round(100 * gulf_2024$allocated_tonnes / gulf_2024$record_tonnes), "%)\n",
  "Untracked landings, no discard estimate:", round(gulf_2024$untracked_catch_tonnes), "t\n"
)
```

## 5. Discard trends by region

One line per marine region. Points mark each year. Discard tonnes are the sum inside the region. Discards per catch are those tonnes divided by the ping catch in the same region.

```{r plot-trends, fig.height=5.5, fig.width=9}
trend <- by_region %>%
  mutate(trend_label = factor(trend_label, levels = region_labels$trend_label))

plot_region_lines <- function(tbl, y, title, ylab) {
  ggplot(tbl, aes(x = year, y = .data[[y]], color = trend_label, group = trend_label)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.85, alpha = 0.95) +
    geom_point(size = 2.4, alpha = 0.95) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = scales::breaks_width(1)) +
    scale_color_manual(values = region_palette, name = "OHI region") +
    labs(
      title = title,
      x = "Year",
      y = ylab
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey92"),
      legend.key.height = grid::unit(0.45, "cm"),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 9)
    )
}

tonnes_plot <- plot_region_lines(
  trend,
  "discard_tonnes",
  "Discard tonnes by OHI region",
  "Discard tonnes"
)
print(tonnes_plot)
ggsave(
  file.path(fig_dir, "discard_tonnes_by_ohi_rgn_trend.png"),
  tonnes_plot,
  width = 9,
  height = 5.5,
  dpi = 300,
  bg = "white"
)

ratio_plot <- plot_region_lines(
  trend,
  "discard_per_catch",
  "Discards per tonne of catch by OHI region",
  "Discards / catch"
)
print(ratio_plot)
ggsave(
  file.path(fig_dir, "discard_per_catch_by_ohi_rgn_trend.png"),
  ratio_plot,
  width = 9,
  height = 5.5,
  dpi = 300,
  bg = "white"
)
```

The regional table is `r summary_path`. The 2018–2024 map is `r raster_path`. The 2024 map is `r raster_2024_path`.
